first_fail_risks.risk: Evidence publication changes the subject under review
first_fail_risks.why: A checker verdict for the product candidate cannot automatically qualify later contract, tooling, or evidence mutations.

first_fail_risks.risk: Evidence commit SHA is embedded into its own hashed content
first_fail_risks.why: Requiring an evidence commit to contain its own final commit SHA creates an unstable self-reference; manifests can have a similar self-inclusion problem.
first_fail_risks.mitigation: Record the finalized evidence SHA in a subsequent publication receipt or separately identified metadata commit, retaining the original evidence commit's candidate parent. Define manifest exclusions explicitly and never amend the frozen commit merely to insert its own SHA.

first_fail_risks.risk: Private or sensitive material leaks through historical checker receipts

first_fail_risks.mitigation: Use an explicit publication allowlist, preserve private raw artifacts locally with digests, scrub public derivatives, and scan the complete intended publication tree before push.
